basic_info.description: Welcome to 7 Wright, a multi-level peaked roof Victorian with exceptional curb appeal and flexible space. This inviting property hosts two bedrooms and one bathroom on the main floor with an additional one bed, one bath, with kitchen and private entrance above. Below, a large garage, tons of storage, a laundry area, and an art studio/workshop overlook the sunny garden. The property offers exceptional views over the San Bruno Mountains and the Bay. Call now to schedule a viewing.
